coverDesign.title: Falanaras, Blood Knight

publicationBook.description:
Drawn from the ruins of Quel’Thalas into a people’s struggle to survive, Falanaras must decide how much of himself he can surrender in the name of duty. Grief, magical hunger, and the demands of a wounded kingdom drive him toward powers that promise strength at a terrible moral cost. As old loyalties fracture and faith is profaned, he searches for a place among soldiers, exiles, and survivors who have each learned to call necessity by a different name.

Set during one of the darkest periods in blood elf history, Falanaras, Blood Knight offers an intimate exploration of a people remade by catastrophe. Through the eyes of one soldier, the novel traces the grief, hunger, fractured faith, and hard choices that shaped the sin’dorei as they struggled to preserve their identity—and decide what survival would require of them.
publicationBook.title: Falanaras, Blood Knight

coverDesign.author: Jonathan Harmon
coverDesign.backCopy: After the Scourge destroys Quel’Thalas, bereaved conscript Falanaras rises through Silvermoon’s shattered ranks as his people turn to increasingly desperate means of survival. Drawn into the capture of the naaru M’uru and the founding of the Blood Knights, he must wield stolen Light against his enemies while confronting the suffering that makes that power possible. As Kael’thas’s betrayal and Silvermoon’s alliance with the Horde redraw every loyalty he once understood, Falanaras fights to preserve his people without surrendering the last limits of his conscience.
